lines.en: : I know how it looks. And I...I don’t blame you for not believing me. But I {i}really{/i} don’t want to get him in trouble because {i}I{/i} am an idiot. It’s all me.
lines.zh: : 我知道这看起来是什么样。我也……我不怪你不信我。但我{i}真的{/i}不想因为{i}我自己{/i}是个白痴就害他惹上麻烦。全是我的问题。

lines.en: : Where did you even learn to talk like that?...Because I’ve seen a lot of vulgar shit in my day, but...western silverbacks? What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿学来说话这套的？……我这辈子见过的下流玩意儿多了去了，可是……「西部银背大猩猩」？那到底是什么意思？
: 那是……一种……大猩猩……
: 是一种大猩猩……

lines.en: : Please just...forget...you read any of that...
lines.zh: : 求你……就当……从没看过那些……
: 这已经……够丢人的了……

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much danger you’d be putting him in by sending that to his phone? Or putting {i}yourself{/i} in by sending it in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道，把那种东西发到他手机上，会给他带来多大的危险？更别说你发出去本身就给{i}自己{/i}带来了多大的危险？

lines.en: : If he actually did show up and wanted to go through with your fucking gorilla shit, what would happen next, Rin?
lines.zh: : 要是他真来了，而且真的打算照你那套大猩猩玩意儿做，接下来会发生什么，Rin？
: 嗯，我……我想我们会……你知道的……

lines.en: : And you’re {i}okay{/i} with that? Fucking a grown man? What happened to Chika? Otoha? Girls your age? Even {i}guys{/i} your age? None of them do it for you anymore? You need adults now?
lines.zh: : 而你对此{i}无所谓{/i}？跟一个成年男人上床？Chika 呢？Otoha 呢？你同龄的女孩？甚至同龄的{i}男生{/i}？他们都不行了吗？你现在非要成年人了？

lines.en: : It’s not {i}adults,{/i} Mom. It’s Sensei. Specifically Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}成年人{/i}，妈。是 Sensei。就只是 Sensei。

lines.en: : And this is obviously some sort of sign or something because I’ve prevented myself from trying to do this for basically forever now and you just {i}happened{/i} to have his phone for some reason the instant I caved.
lines.zh: : 而且这显然是某种征兆之类的，因为我几乎一直都在阻止自己去做这件事，可就在我屈服的那一瞬间，你不知为什么{i}偏偏{/i}拿着他的手机。

lines.en: : I still have it. I left in such a rush that I forgot to give it back.
lines.zh: : 我手机还在我这儿。我走得太急，忘了还给他。

lines.en: : That stuff I sent...it’s not all...still in there, is it?
lines.zh: : 我发的那些东西……不会……都还在里面吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. Do you think I’d just hand it back over to him without doing anything? What, so we can watch you fuck yourself together?
lines.zh: : 当然不会了。你以为我会什么都不做就直接还给他吗？怎么，好让我们俩一起看你自慰？

lines.en: : No! And could you please stop bringing that up? This is already the single most embarrassing thing that’s ever happened to me and that’s only making it worse.
lines.zh: : 不！还有你能不能别再提那个了？这已经是我这辈子最丢脸的事了，你这么说只会让它更糟。

lines.en: : I just need you to understand how wrong-
lines.zh: : 我只是需要你明白这有多——

lines.en: : I know! I know how fucking wrong it is! That’s why it’s fucking killing me! I don’t {i}want{/i} to like him, but I do!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我知道这他妈有多错！正因为知道，我才他妈快要死了！我不{i}想{/i}喜欢他，可我就是喜欢！

lines.en: : And it’s confusing as fuck hearing from my therapist and friends and {i}everyone{/i} else that I need to do what will make {i}me{/i} happy when all of the things that {i}might{/i} are specifically the things I’m supposed to avoid!
lines.zh: : 从心理医生、朋友到{i}所有{/i}其他人，都在跟我说要做让{i}自己{/i}快乐的事，可所有{i}可能{/i}让我快乐的事，偏偏又都是我应该回避的事——这他妈让我困惑死了！

lines.en: : I’m confused! I’m scared! I’m horny! And I want to die, but I don’t! So what am I supposed to do?! Just wait it out?! We already know medication doesn’t work! So what do I do, Mom??! Tell me! Help me!
lines.zh: : 我困惑！我害怕！我饥渴！我想死，可我又不想死！那我到底该怎么办？！就这么干等着？！我们已经知道药物没用了！那我该怎么办，妈？！告诉我！帮帮我！

lines.en: : Why do you think I’m here?...
lines.zh: : 你以为我是来干什么的？……
: 来惩罚我的？……

lines.en: : I mean...yeah, obviously. If you’re going to take my phone away and talk to me about how stupid I am. Because {i}that{/i} doesn’t help at all.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……对，显然是啊。你要没收我的手机，还要跟我说我有多蠢。因为{i}那{/i}根本一点用都没有。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry, but I don’t possess the magic cure to being a teenager. We {i}all{/i} do stupid shit at your age. I just never thought that {i}this{/i} would be a talk we needed to have.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉，但我并没有治疗「青春期」的灵丹妙药。你这个年纪，{i}谁都{/i}会干蠢事。我只是从没想过，我们居然需要进行{i}这样{/i}一场对话。

lines.en: : Hey, uhh...I’ll leave if this is a...family thing. I just...heard some screaming and...wanted to make sure Rin was okay.
lines.zh: : 嗨，呃……如果这是……家事的话我就不打扰了。我只是……听到有人在喊……想过来确认一下 Rin 没事。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Rin did some very {i}stupid{/i} shit tonight. But I’ll let her fill you in on it since I’ve {i}embarrassed{/i} her enough already.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，Rin 今晚干了件非常{i}蠢{/i}的事。不过我让她自己跟你说吧，毕竟我已经让她够{i}难堪{/i}了。

lines.en: This is what you get for waiting so long.
lines.zh: 这就是让你等了这么久的下场。
